links.title: Signals to Watch →
links.tooltip: Threshold signals — review engagement ratio, AI share, escape rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite', 'likely')
SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'none'
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE gate_policy_blocked = true)::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE gate_policy_blocked IS NOT NULL), 0) FROM pr_metrics
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE consistency_finding_count > 0)::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE consistency_finding_count IS NOT NULL), 0) FROM pr_metrics

panels.title: AI vs Human PR Volume Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, count(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg. Time to Merge (minutes) — AI vs Human

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM escape_records WHERE detection_method IN ('manual', 'commit-linked')

panels.title: Escaped Defects — Heuristic (best-effort)
panels.description: Time-window correlation, not a confirmed causal link — see FR-5.6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM escape_records WHERE detection_method = 'time-window-heuristic'

panels.title: AI — Definite
panels.description: PRs with a Co-Authored-By AI trailer (highest-confidence signal).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'definite'

panels.title: AI — Likely
panels.description: PRs matching an AI branch pattern or PR-template marker, but no commit trailer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'likely'

panels.title: Avg Review Comments — AI
panels.description: Mean review_comment_count for AI-authored PRs (definite + likely).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(review_comment_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite', 'likely')
SELECT round(avg(review_comment_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'none'

panels.title: Avg. Time to First Review (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: How quickly PRs receive a first review, split by authorship.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(time_to_first_review_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(time_to_first_review_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg. Review Comment Count — AI vs Human
panels.description: Weekly average reviewer engagement per PR, by authorship.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(review_comment_count) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(review_comment_count) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg Consistency Findings per AI PR
panels.description: Mean number of naming/error-handling findings on AI-authored PRs (confidence: definite or likely) where the consistency checker ran.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(consistency_finding_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE consistency_finding_count IS NOT NULL AND confidence IN ('definite', 'likely')

panels.title: Escaped Defects Over Time
panels.description: Weekly count of newly-detected escapes, split by detection method.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', detected_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE detection_method IN ('manual','commit-linked')) AS confirmed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE detection_method = 'time-window-heuristic') AS heuristic FROM escape_records WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
